title: Template -- Web scanner user-agent in HTTP access logs
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin canonical templates
description: Canonical Sigma detection template for MITRE ATT&CK T1595.002 (Active Scanning: Vulnerability Scanning). Detects HTTP access logs where the client identifies itself as a common vulnerability or content-discovery scanner. It is a narrow, passive indicator of scanning against services you operate, not proof of malicious intent or a substitute for rate and request-pattern analysis. Synthetic exemplar from the WinstonRedGuard threat-intel corpus -- no actor binding; review and bind to your environment before deployment.
